study: Public contamination-table qualification and bounded reanalysis
scope: Published aggregate tables; no new model runs, no raw causal reconstruction, no independent correctness labels
exploratory_information_already_seen: Schemas, per-file row/task counts, and author join/statistic code were inspected before this record. This is not external preregistration.
questions: Are table join keys unique and how much token/trace coverage overlaps?
Which source-reported aggregate counts can be independently recomputed?
Which proposed correctness-sensitive analyses lack required released fields?
rules: Do not infer incorrectness from answer_changed
Do not impute missing correctness as false
Do not merge across model identities
Report unmatched rows and duplicate keys
Do not train a manifestation classifier using fields that define manifestation labels
publication_claim: Data suitability and replication evidence only; standalone novelty unestablished
